raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 18
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced an unverified list of 1959 “dehydrated” and frozen items and then shifted to a mock calculation using placeholder counts instead of extracting and verifying actual standards and supersessions. This also conflated fresh-produce AMS updates (e.g., removing “Unclassified”) with processed/dehydrated standards. That decision diverted the workflow from evidence-based comparison and directly led to the unsupported final answer (38%).
